use_cases: Application navigation dock with icon magnification effect on hover, similar to macOS dock
Quick access toolbar for frequently used actions in productivity applications
Floating navigation bar with smooth spring-based animations
Icon launcher for application dashboards and admin panels
Tab switching interface with proximity-based item enlargement
ai_summary: A macOS-style animated dock navigation component with spring physics and magnetic magnification effects. Items scale up smoothly based on mouse proximity, creating an elegant hover interaction. Built with motion/react for performant spring animations and supports customizable panel height, magnification strength, and distance thresholds. Ideal for creating polished, desktop-class navigation experiences in web applications.
